_provenance: A spelling enters this file only when a header in one of the corpora uses it, or is that header's obvious abbreviation. Synonyms added to improve a score are forbidden: this lexicon is the control for every claim about what the model contributes.

The English-looking spellings are observed, not imported. familyName, additionalName, birthDate, gender, description: literal column names in deputies/0427f07d-5b47-4d7c-996f-5077ca4b56fe.csv. prefLabel, altLabel, headFn: literal column names in orgbook/0402708c-3d69-4f32-9b48-71dbd97719fd.xlsx.

A key must be a property a COLUMN can satisfy, so no entity-typed property may appear here: retrieval no longer offers one (vocab/shortlist.py) and the grammar cannot express a binding to one (Catalogue.bindable), which would make such an entry unmatchable and therefore a silent lie about what this file covers. Two were: Membership:organization held фракція, партія, політична партія, підрозділ, структурний підрозділ, and Occupancy:post held посада, должность, займана посада. Those headers name the value of an organization's name and of a position, not the reference to either, so the observed spellings moved to Organization:name and Position:name; посада and должность were already under Person:position and Position:name.
